# Crossing oceans

## Authors

- Eve Marder<sup>1</sup> †

### Affiliations

1. Department of Biology and the Volen National Center for Complex Systems Brandeis University Waltham United States marder@brandeis.edu

† Corresponding author

## Abstract

Eve Marder explains why all scientists should spend time living and working in a foreign country.

results.result_reasoning: Claims C1–C4 represent author metadata and institutional affiliation information that is directly stated in the manuscript header. These are factual statements about authorship and institutional location that can be verified from the document itself and do not require experimental validation or additional evidence.

Claims C5 and C6 represent the thesis of the manuscript—that scientists should spend time abroad and that reasons exist to support this position. However, the actual arguments, evidence, and reasoning are not provided in the excerpt (only the title and abstract are shown). Without access to the full manuscript content where the explanatory reasons would be presented, it is impossible to evaluate whether the position is well-supported by evidence, logical argumentation, or empirical data.
